origin.author: jallred
origin.text: DNA is an idea, not a 1:1 sentence mapping. Revisions are codified alternate readings of the same idea with different presentations. Bones are the transitory scratchpad between raw original text and the database, and the spine provides the narrative order.

synthesis.title: The Granularity Triad: DNA Ideas, Certified Revisions, and Narrative Spines
synthesis.narrative_context: Decouples atomic semantic meaning from narrative sequence. An idea is an invariant concept with multiple certified revisions, while a spine provides the linear sequential structure.
synthesis.review_notes: Inaugural VIBE card formalizing the mental model of knowledge granularity.

mutations.text: We decouple semantic concepts from presentation: ideas hold invariant meaning, revisions capture alternate readings, and spines sequence the narrative.
Eliminated knowledge duplication by separating semantic units from presentation lenses, allowing unified data reuse across documentation and resumes.

origin.author: jallred
origin.text: Knowledge repositories without continuous pruning degenerate into noisy data graveyards. A living memory metabolism requires active feedback pressure, semantic density culling, and the regular retirement of stale assumptions to sustain emergent intelligence.

synthesis.title: Living Metabolism & Continuous Pruning
synthesis.narrative_context: Knowledge stores require continuous feedback and metabolic culling. Without active pruning, context windows saturate with noisy or outdated assumptions.
synthesis.review_notes: VIBE card establishing living knowledge metabolism.

revisions.text: Knowledge repositories without continuous pruning degenerate into noisy data graveyards. A living memory metabolism requires active feedback pressure.

origin.author: jallred
origin.text: Loops birth complexity. The simplest non-linear equation, like the Logistic Map, generates infinite fractal depth from trivial feedback. In systems architecture and agent swarms, complexity is not built by adding code—it emerges spontaneously when outputs are looped back as inputs with back-pressure.

synthesis.title: Feedback Loops as Complexity Engines
synthesis.narrative_context: Complex behavior arises from tight iterative feedback loops rather than complicated monolithic designs. Small functions with recursive feedback generate high-order emergent capabilities.
synthesis.review_notes: VIBE card establishing feedback loops as complexity drivers.

revisions.text: Loops birth complexity. In systems architecture and agent swarms, complexity emerges spontaneously when outputs are looped back as inputs with back-pressure.
